plugins.name: Elixir
plugins.description: Elixir, EEx and HEEx: highlighting, and the language server (Expert where installed, ElixirLS otherwise) for completion, hover, definition, diagnostics and formatting

plugins.name: Image viewer
plugins.description: Shows pictures (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, TIFF, ICO, QOI, TGA, PNM, DDS, OpenEXR, HDR, SVG) with zoom, pan, turns and their EXIF information; a JPEG is turned or flipped by its orientation tag only

plugins.name: PDF viewer
plugins.description: Shows PDF files (ISO 32000) page by page with their outline, page labels and links; search, copy and the terminal read the pages' text

plugins.name: Excel workbooks
plugins.description: Opens, edits and saves Excel workbooks (.xlsx, .xlsm) as themselves: only the edited cells change, charts, pivot tables and macros are kept byte for byte
